## ADR checklist
- [ ] Title is decision-shaped and the id matches the filename
- [ ] Mapped to products / platforms that exist in `taxonomy.yml`
- [ ] Options considered include at least one rejected alternative
- [ ] GxP / GDP impact and security review stated
- [ ] Linked tech debt items or tickets in Follow-ups
- [ ] Status set correctly (proposed → accepted only after ARB sign-off)
